job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
The IT Project Manager role is focused on delivering technology projects, or the technology components of a larger business project, across the technology landscape spanning both enterprise and business technology groups.
This role sits within the Technology department, reporting through to the CTO. The role is responsible for the successful delivery of technology projects in accordance with approved business cases and the realisation of all identified benefits, while adhering to project management disciplines and governance processes.
It is essential that candidates are well versed in both waterfall and agile methodologies, with adequate experience successfully delivering technology project scope and benefits on time and on budget, ensuring key stakeholder expectations are well managed at all times, leading a project team, managing shared resources to deliver project outcomes, and ensuring external vendors and delivery partners deliver to agreed scope and standards.

Responsibilities:
  • Ensure the successful delivery of projects
  • Engage business stakeholders, validating requirements and success metrics for the project
  • Manage the project schedule, monitoring and addressing variations to timelines and scope
  • Accountable for cost control and adherence to project budgets
  • Identify, log and drive resolution of issues, risks, dependencies and assumptions
  • Day-to-day task management and outcomes of nominated project resources
  • Manage project compliance with governance requirements and program alignment to technology strategy
  • Manage technology changes through the relevant technology change review/approval forums
To be successful in this role, you will need:
  • Strong problem solving and decision making
  • Prioritisation of business requirements
  • Stakeholder alignment and solution endorsement
  • Technical and people conflict resolution

  • Education

  • Access to a collaborative and experienced cross-functional team
  • Exposure to major commercial projects and high-growth sectors
  • A values-led culture built around teamwork, respect, integrity and accountability
  • A business that encourages new ideas, initiative and entrepreneurial thinking
Ready for Your Next Challenge? If you're a proactive, commercially minded sales professional who understands the building products market and enjoys building influential relationships, this is an opportunity to take your career to the next level.

job.title: Program Manager - Cyber Security
job.description:
Program Manager - Cyber Security 
Contract: (6-12 months)
Location: Sydney
Rate: $1400-$1600
Working Arrangement: Hybird
 
We are looking for an experienced Contract Program Manager - Cyber Security to lead the delivery of a portfolio of strategic cyber security initiatives. This is an opportunity to work across technology, risk, security and business teams to deliver complex programs that strengthen the organizations cyber resilience and security posture.
 
About the Role
 
As the Cyber Security Program Manager, you will be responsible for planning, governing and delivering multiple cyber security projects and initiatives from inception through to completion.
 
You will work closely with senior stakeholders, Cyber Security leadership, technology teams, risk and compliance functions, and external vendors to ensure programs are delivered on time, within budget and to the required quality and security standards.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of cyber security programs and projects.
  • Develop and maintain program plans, roadmaps, milestones, budgets and delivery schedules.
  • Establish strong program governance, reporting and risk management frameworks.
  • Manage dependencies, risks, issues and change across multiple workstreams.
  • Provide clear and concise reporting to senior leadership and governance committees.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across Cyber Security, Technology, Risk, Compliance and business functions.
  • Manage third-party vendors, consultants and delivery partners where required.
  • Ensure security initiatives align with organisational strategy, risk appetite and regulatory requirements.
  • Drive delivery of cyber security capabilities, controls and remediation initiatives.
  • Identify delivery risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies.
  • Facilitate steering committees, working groups and program governance forums.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation, assurance and handover activities are completed.
  • Support continuous improvement of cyber security program delivery practices.
About You
 
You will be an accomplished Program Manager with demonstrated experience delivering complex cyber security or technology programs in large and/or highly regulated environments.
 
You will bring:
  • Significant experience managing complex technology or cyber security programs.
  • Strong understanding of cyber security principles, risks and controls.
  • Proven experience working with senior executives and diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Strong program governance, financial management and reporting capabilities.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and delivery teams.
  • Excellent risk, issue, dependency and change management skills.
  • Strong vendor and third-party management experience.
  • Exceptional communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
  • A pragmatic, outcomes-focused approach with the ability to operate in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience working within Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery methodologies.
Desirable Experience
 
Experience across one or more of the following areas would be highly regarded:
  • Cyber security uplift and remediation programs
  • Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • Security Operations / SOC
  • Vulnerability and patch management
  • Cloud security
  • Data security and protection
  • Security architecture
  • Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)
  • Cyber resilience and incident response
  • Regulatory or compliance-driven security programs
  • Security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, Essential Eight or similar

job.title: Ellucian Banner Tech Lead
job.description:
Ellucian Banner Technical Lead 
Open to applicants across Australia 
$200,000 Base + super 

Our client is looking for an The Ellucian Banner Tech Lead is responsible for leading the design, development, and delivery of Ellucian Banner ERP solutions across the organization.

This role combines hands on technical expertise with cloud service models, including Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS), and the integration with enterprise education systems such as Ellucian Banner.
  
This role will drive Banner solution architecture and guide development practices across Banner and integrated platforms, including Salesforce CRM systems, learning management systems (Canvas), and middleware technologies such as Informatica.
  
Principal accountabilities include (but are not limited to):
  • Provide technical leadership and governance for the Ellucian Banner ecosystem, establishing and enforcing development standards, coding practices, architectural principles, and quality assurance processes across Banner applications, Oracle databases, integrations, and supporting technologies.
  • Lead the design, development, enhancement, and support of Banner ERP solutions across Student, Finance, Human Resources, Payroll, and related modules, ensuring solutions align with institutional objectives, regulatory requirements, and business processes.
  • Act as the senior technical authority for Banner architecture, designing scalable and sustainable solutions that align with enterprise architecture standards and support integration with platforms including CRM, LMS, identity management, reporting, data warehouse, and middleware solutions.
  • Design, develop, and oversee Banner integrations using Banner APIs, Ethos Integration, Application Navigator, Oracle PL/SQL, web services, ETL frameworks, and middleware platforms, ensuring secure, reliable, and high-quality data exchange across enterprise systems.
  • Provide advanced technical expertise in Oracle database administration, Banner customisation, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis, serving as the highest escalation point for complex production issues and critical incidents.
  
Who you are

job.title: Data/AI Lead
job.description:
The Opportunity

An exciting opportunity has become available for an experienced Data & AI Lead to shape and lead an organisation’s growing Data and Artificial Intelligence capability.

This is a senior, commercially focused leadership role combining data, reporting and insights with the practical implementation of AI and automation initiatives.

You will bridge the gap between business leaders and technical teams, translating commercial challenges into scalable Data and AI solutions. The organisation already has an established AI strategy; your responsibility will be to define the direction, identify opportunities and lead its execution.

This role is ideal for someone who can think strategically while remaining close enough to the technology to understand what is possible and guide hands-on delivery.
  
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the strategic direction and execution of the organisation’s Data and AI capability.
  • Bring the Data and AI functions together under one cohesive operating model.
  • Manage and mentor a small team of AI Engineers and Data professionals.
  • Partner with business leaders across Sales, Marketing, Operations and other functions.
  • Translate business challenges into practical Data, AI and automation initiatives.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve revenue, growth, customer acquisition and sales conversion.
  • Develop roadmaps, solution concepts and delivery blueprints for engineering teams.
  • Lead the delivery of end-to-end AI-enabled business processes.
  • Provide commercially informed recommendations on where AI and automation can deliver the greatest value.
  • Ensure initiatives are linked to measurable KPIs and business outcomes.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to senior and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Remain close to delivery and contribute to solution design where required.
  • Monitor emerging AI technologies, frameworks and market innovations.
  
About You
You are an experienced Data and AI leader who combines technical credibility with strong commercial awareness. You can engage confidently with business leaders, understand their challenges and translate these into realistic solutions for technical teams to deliver.
You are proactive, naturally curious and comfortable setting direction rather than waiting for requirements to be provided. Most importantly, you are a hands-on leader who enjoys turning ideas into measurable outcomes.
  
Essential Experience
  • Demonstrated experience leading Data, Analytics, AI or Automation initiatives.
  • Practical experience delivering AI projects from concept through to implementation.
  • Experience designing or implementing end-to-end business processes using AI agents.
  • Strong understanding of agentic AI, beyond traditional chatbot solutions.
  • Knowledge of multi-agent models, sub-agents and modern AI architecture.
  • Experience with AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraphor similar.
  • Exposure to cloud-based AI environments, preferably AWS/azure
  • Strong Data, Reporting, Analytics and Insights experience.
  • Experience leading and mentoring technical professionals.
  • Ability to define direction and create actionable delivery roadmaps.
  • Strong stakeholder management and business communication skills.
  • Demonstrated commercial acumen and the ability to connect technology initiatives to measurable outcomes.
  • Comfortable operating in a smaller, fast-moving environment with broad responsibilities.
  
Highly Desirable
  • Experience delivering initiatives that have:
  • Increased revenue
  • Improved sales conversion
  • Reduced customer acquisition costs
  • Enhanced marketing performance
  • Improved measurable business KPIs
  • Experience within general insurance, life insurance, banking, superannuation, financial servicesor another commercially focused industry.
  • Previous experience presenting recommendations to executive or senior leadership teams.
  • Experience combining or leading overlapping Data and AI functions.
  
Leadership Style

We are seeking someone who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will be expected to:
  • Set the direction for Data and AI initiatives.
  • Act as the connection between business stakeholders and technical teams.
  • Make proactive recommendations based on business needs.
  • Understand what is technically achievable.
  • Empower engineers with clear direction and delivery blueprints.
  • Communicate effectively across all levels of the organisation.
  
This is not a purely advisory or strategy-focused position. The successful person must be a proactive doer who can turn commercial opportunities into practical, deliverable solutions.
  
What’s on Offer
  • Leadership role with ownership of the Data and AI function.
  • Opportunity to shape how AI supports commercial growth across the organisation.
  • Direct access to senior business stakeholders.
  • Leadership of a capable and growing technical team.
  • Broad remit with the opportunity to make a visible enterprise-wide impact.
If this sounds like you, apply and all suitable candidates will be contacted.

Sydney based candidates only with full working rights will be considered.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer (Platform)
job.description:
This role would suit someone who is a strong Senior C# Engineer looking to work in a Platform team: build Bicep IaC, Azure serverless tooling & dev blueprints that make every other engineer's life easier.

Role Overview
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. This role is focused on infrastructure and platform capability, not on building product APIs. You'll design and write Infrastructure as Code, build the templates and blueprints that other developers rely on, and help evolve how the wider engineering organisation builds, tests, and ships software.

This role suits someone who genuinely enjoys "just" doing infrastructure as code and who wants to make life better for the developers who use what you build.

While this role has a strong focus on Infrastructure as Code and Azure platform engineering, we're specifically looking for an experienced Senior C# engineer who enjoys applying software engineering practices to cloud infrastructure and platform development.

Key Responsibilities:
Infrastructure as Code & Platform Capability
  • Write, maintain, and improve Infrastructure as Code across Azure.
  • Build and maintain reusable Bicep templates and modules that other developers can consume directly.
  • Write unit tests for infrastructure code, treating it with the same rigour as application code.
  • Design everything with a dev-centric mindset - the goal is to make it easy and intuitive for other engineers to self-serve infrastructure, not just to make it work.
  • Produce blueprints and reference architectures, supported by clear diagrams, that development teams can pick up and use with minimal guidance.
Cloud Architecture
  • Design, build, and maintain platform tooling and automation using C#.
  • Apply current Microsoft Landing Zone patterns and practices.
  • Design and build with Azure-native services including Event Grid, Front Door, Azure Functions, and Logic Apps.
  • Default to serverless architectures wherever practical, particularly for lower-traffic workloads, to reduce cost and operational overhead.
Platform & Delivery
  • Support and help drive the GitHub migration, including following it through to completion across affected teams.
  • Contribute to the CI/CD platform and identify practical ways to accelerate software delivery.
  • Write clear technical designs, including Key Design Decisions (KDDs) and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), and maintain good record-keeping practices.
  • Explore and apply AI tooling to improve engineering and delivery workflows.
Ways of Working & Communication
  • Participate in Three Amigos sessions as part of the team's ways of working.
  • Review pull requests thoughtfully and provide constructive, timely feedback.
  • Communicate clearly with both engineers and stakeholders, particularly when explaining infrastructure and platform decisions.
About You
  • Senior-level experience in cloud application development is preferred. Candidates who demonstrate an interest in platform engineering and a willingness to develop platform-focused expertise will be highly valued.
  • Strong hands-on Senior level experience with .NET on Azure and/or AWS
  • Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code tooling: Bicep, Terraform, Pulumi, or AWS CDK.
  • Familiarity with current Microsoft Landing Zone architecture and patterns is preferred.
  • Experience with serverless services such as Event Grid, Front Door, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, or equivalent AWS services.
  • Comfortable writing unit tests for infrastructure and platform code.
  • A genuine platform mindset - motivated by enabling other developers rather than shipping product features directly.
  • Experience with, or strong interest in, GitHub-based CI/CD and developer workflow tooling.

Role is based in Melbourne CBD
Offered as a Hybrid, with 1-2 office days per week. 
Contract: 6months initially - extendible depending on performance/project
Daily Rate: starting at $1000+ per day. 

Only applicants with full working rights and based in Melbourne will be considered for this role. Please make sure you have your location on your resume when applying.

job.title: Recruitment Specialist - Sydney
job.description:
Recruitment Specialist - Sydney
  
WHO IS PRA?   

PRA is a leading Digital & IT Recruitment company with offices in Brisbane, Sydney, Canberra and Melbourne.
  
PRA offers all its employees’ industry leading financial incentives, flexible working arrangements, training and genuine career growth in Sydney and interstate.
 
Some of the key benefits are;

  • High financial rewards with commission up to 50%
  • Cloud based technology, so you can work from home or on the move
  • External / Internal training and continuous improvement programs
  • Career opportunities into management
  • Work Perks such as up to 25 days leave per year, team events, lunch clubs, sales comps and many more.  
  
What is the role?   
Working out of our very cool Sydney office, you will build your own accounts and networks. We will help you to develop your business and ensure your success as a best in class recruitment and technology professional.

You are able to work on both contract and permanent roles and you can build up significant revenue streams whilst placing permanent candidates. 

We have multiple positions available, such as:
  • Candidate Manager 
  • Associate Consultatant
  • Recruitment Consultant
  • Senior Consultant
  • Managing Consultant
  • Principal Consultant
  • Client Services Manager   
Consultants within PRA are responsible to develop long term relationships with clients and to offer a professional and effective service to clients and candidates.  Delivery and the style of the delivery are paramount to maintain and develop the image of PRA as a leading supplier of recruitment solutions.
What will you do?
  • Selling and promoting PRA’s services to existing and new customers
  • Expanding PRA’s reach within each customer through business development activities
  • Managing and maintaining client accounts for PRA’s services through consistent communication and client visits
  • Assessing clients’ needs and providing services and solutions that satisfy client requirements
  • Co-ordinating with PRA’s internal resources to ensure customers receive best in class service
  • Providing timely and regular reporting to both internal and external stakeholders
  • Utilising market knowledge to pitch new clients and win new business
  • Dealing with clients & candidates, developing long term effective relationships
  • Negotiating rates with clients, both contract and permanent
  • Giving presentations to clients
  • Handling clients and applicants through recruitment process to successful conclusion
  • Writing advertisement copy
  • Selection of applicants for vacancies
  • Interviewing applicants
  • Arranging interviews with clients and candidates
  • Ensuring contact is made on a regular basis with contractors once placed out on the client’s site
  • Maintaining awareness of trends within area of technical specialisation
  • Ensuring that contact is made with clients on a regular basis and updating the database
What kind of person thrives in the PRA environment?   

Communication and people management are the defining elements of this role.  To perform it successfully, a candidate will need to be confident, and possess the ability to inform and persuade others and effectively present both themselves and the organisation they represent.  Friendliness and charisma are important factors in performing such a job effectively, together with the ability to put others at their ease.

Attention to detail, responsiveness and adaptability are also key elements in this job.  You will have energy and enthusiasm, and the ability to deal confidently with changes in work environments and situations.  The job often calls for work to meet deadlines or be completed within short timescales, and the ideal candidates will be prepared to commit themselves if they are to succeed.

Recruitment is challenging and fast-moving, and there are times you will practice patience to see through a difficult time or a minor repetitive task.  Having said this, you will see that these periods as necessary to your personal advancement and will contribute to your own goals in life, and in return you will work towards a career that is rewarding and flexible!
What will you have done before?   
  • Min 2 years experience working with a range of stakeholders within the recruitment industry
  • Excellent communication skills, both written & verbal
  • Working autonomously & within a team, doing everything in your power to ensure your colleagues success as well as your own- recognising that the greater teams’ success will always benefit you personally
  • Attention to detail and an enjoyment of being busy; managing multiple moving pieces at one time
  • Min 2 years experience in a Business Development capacity
This role attracts a Base salary of $89,000- $100,000 Pkg+ OTE  

Apply now for immediate consideration

An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced IT Network & Systems Administrator to join a growing global technology organisation based in Bella Vista.
 
This is a hands-on role responsible for managing, supporting and optimising a broad technology environment spanning Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, DevOps, NetSuite, FortiGate, SQL, proprietary applications and hardware.
 
You'll play a key role in maintaining the reliability, security and performance of the organisation's IT environment while providing high-quality technical support to internal users. The role will also contribute to infrastructure, development, integration and technology improvement projects.

  • Manage and troubleshoot corporate LAN, WAN, wireless, firewalls and VPN environments.
